_readme: Fred Pinkerton's sumo ranking charts (https://fredpink.com/), linked from the Banzuke panel (js/banzuke.js).

The three-basho chart is his main one: right after a basho it shows the last three tournaments' results; once the new banzuke is out it shows the last two results plus the new banzuke, with promotions/demotions between Makuuchi and Juryo marked as bars (per his own notes on the site).

The wp.me short links below are the ones his page uses for 'Save As JPG' / 'Save As PDF'; the address stays the same when he posts a new version, so nothing here needs updating per basho. His site offers JPG and PDF (no PNG).
Links only, by design: nothing is embedded or hotlinked from his site. Ask him first if you ever want to show the chart inline.
